```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
options(scipen = 999, dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
```

```{r packages}
required_pkgs <- c("tidyverse", "tidymodels", "ranger", "arrow")

missing_pkgs <- setdiff(required_pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required packages: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "))
}

invisible(lapply(required_pkgs, function(pkg) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(pkg, character.only = TRUE))
}))

tidymodels::tidymodels_prefer()
set.seed(7900)
```

```{r paths}
input_feature_path <- "C:/Data/Spring 2026/CPLN 7900/explore/predictive_modeling_final_handoff/01_feature_table/final_predictive_feature_table.parquet"

if (!file.exists(input_feature_path)) {
  stop("Final predictive feature table parquet not found: ", input_feature_path)
}

out_dir <- "C:/Data/Spring 2026/CPLN 7900/explore/final_model_training_clean"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

out_model_rds <- file.path(out_dir, "final_rf_model_workflow.rds")
```

```{r load-final-feature-table}
final_tbl <- arrow::read_parquet(input_feature_path) %>%
  as_tibble()

stopifnot(nrow(final_tbl) > 0, ncol(final_tbl) > 0)

if (!"trip_date" %in% names(final_tbl)) {
  stop("trip_date is required in the final feature table.")
}
```

```{r predictors-and-target}
final_predictors <- c(
  "alightings_lag_7d",
  "boardings_lag_7d",
  "curr_stop_shared_stop_flag",
  "curr_vessel_count_lag_7d",
  "direction",
  "expected_water_min",
  "is_terminal_stop",
  "planned_turnaround_gap_min",
  "prev_stop_sched_hour",
  "prev_stop_shared_stop_flag",
  "prev_vessel_count_lag_7d",
  "schedule_daytype",
  "schedule_season",
  "scheduled_headway_min",
  "stop_sequence",
  "vessel_capacity",
  "vessel_trip_seq_in_chain",
  "env_battery_water_level_obs",
  "env_narrows_current_obs",
  "env_precipitation_mm",
  "env_temperature_c",
  "env_visibility_m",
  "env_wind_speed_mps",
  "from_stop_id",
  "to_stop_id",
  "segment_hourly_vessel_count_all"
)

categorical_predictors <- c(
  "curr_stop_shared_stop_flag",
  "direction",
  "is_terminal_stop",
  "prev_stop_shared_stop_flag",
  "schedule_daytype",
  "schedule_season",
  "from_stop_id",
  "to_stop_id"
)

required_columns <- c(
  "trip_date",
  final_predictors,
  "lateness_vs_original_schedule_min"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(final_tbl))
if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
}

model_tbl <- final_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    trip_date = as.Date(trip_date),
    delay_gt_10 = if_else(
      lateness_vs_original_schedule_min > 10,
      "yes",
      "no",
      missing = "no"
    ) %>%
      factor(levels = c("no", "yes"))
  ) %>%
  select(trip_date, all_of(final_predictors), delay_gt_10) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(categorical_predictors),
      ~ as.factor(as.character(.x))
    )
  )

stopifnot(all(final_predictors %in% names(model_tbl)))
stopifnot("delay_gt_10" %in% names(model_tbl))
stopifnot(all(vapply(model_tbl[categorical_predictors], is.factor, logical(1))))
```

```{r train-validation-test-split}
max_date <- max(model_tbl$trip_date, na.rm = TRUE)

test_start <- max_date - 30
val_start <- test_start - 30

train_full <- model_tbl %>%
  filter(trip_date < val_start)

validation <- model_tbl %>%
  filter(trip_date >= val_start, trip_date < test_start)

test <- model_tbl %>%
  filter(trip_date >= test_start)

stopifnot(nrow(train_full) > 0)
stopifnot(nrow(validation) > 0)
stopifnot(nrow(test) > 0)
stopifnot(n_distinct(train_full$delay_gt_10) == 2)
```

```{r recipe-and-model}
rf_recipe <- recipe(
  delay_gt_10 ~ .,
  data = train_full %>%
    select(all_of(final_predictors), delay_gt_10)
) %>%
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_novel(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors())

rf_spec <- rand_forest(
  mode = "classification",
  trees = 1500,
  mtry = 5,
  min_n = 25
) %>%
  set_engine(
    "ranger",
    importance = "impurity",
    probability = TRUE,
    splitrule = "gini",
    num.threads = max(1L, parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE) - 1L)
  )
```

```{r fit-and-save-final-workflow}
final_rf_workflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(rf_recipe) %>%
  add_model(rf_spec) %>%
  fit(
    data = train_full %>%
      select(all_of(final_predictors), delay_gt_10)
  )

saveRDS(final_rf_workflow, out_model_rds)

loaded_workflow <- readRDS(out_model_rds)
stopifnot(inherits(loaded_workflow, "workflow"))

message("Final RF workflow saved: ", out_model_rds)
```
